investigations.name: eukaryogenesis
investigations.title: The Endosymbiotic Transition
investigations.description: A branching, evidence-grounded campaign that constructs, tests, compares, and composes mechanistic explanations for the endosymbiotic transition. Each study carries its own assumptions, parameter ranges, evidence links, interventions, model versions, and validators, and keeps four classes of evidence strictly separate — each with its proper interpretation: (1) modern proxy observation (e.g. Asgard protrusion geometry and motility) constrains plausible mechanism and parameters, but is not a direct ancestral observation; (2) genomic / phylogenetic evidence (gene histories, transporters, energy metabolism) sets priors on ancestral states and models their uncertainty, it does not fix an ordering; (3) a model demonstration (stable spatial mutualism, a dynamically closed membrane, net ATP export) establishes mechanistic possibility in a stated parameter region, not historical fact; (4) historical inference (the specific ordering of integration events) can be weighed by model comparison but cannot be established by simulation alone.
investigations.question: Under what physical, metabolic, ecological, and evolutionary conditions can an archaeal host and a bacterial partner cross from ecological association to a stable, integrated eukaryotic lineage? Endosymbiotic integration is treated not as a single event but as a succession of barriers — biochemical, spatial, mechanical, energetic, and reproductive — each of which must be crossed on plausible terms. The aim is to identify which combinations of mechanisms make the crossings possible, which make them impossible, and which competing histories remain consistent with the surviving evidence — not to animate a predetermined origin story.
investigations.hypothesis: The endosymbiotic transition is persuasive only if each barrier-crossing (exchange, proximity, enclosure, physiology, individuality, complexity) emerges from plausible preceding conditions, conserves the relevant physical quantities (mass, charge, electron, free energy), improves or at least preserves lineage fitness, and persists through generations. Each crossing introduces new benefits and new constraints; the discovery problem is which mechanism combinations let cooperation become stable cellular integration, and which alternative histories the evidence cannot yet rule out.

investigations.name: origins-of-life-vent
investigations.title: The Hydrothermal Vent Hypothesis
investigations.description: A staged, falsifiable Vivarium campaign mapping where the geology-to-cells path at a serpentinizing alkaline hydrothermal vent runs continuously, where it depends on narrow regimes, and where it breaks. A cellular origin is treated as five acts of coupled nonequilibrium transitions — geological engine, chemical organization, chemical individuality, reproduction and evolution, robustness and autonomy — each judged against a matched null with input fluxes held equal, with explicit competing scenarios. Not a demonstration that cells did originate at vents: a quantitative map of the bottlenecks between geology and cells.
investigations.question: Could the first cells have originated at alkaline hydrothermal vents — and where does the geology-to-cells path run continuously, where does it depend on narrow regimes, and where does it break? Can a physically plausible early-Earth vent–ocean interface generate and sustain, in order, the free energy, reduced carbon, persistent network chemistry, concentration, and compartments a protocell needs — without inserting metabolism, membranes, autocatalysis, or heredity by assumption?
investigations.hypothesis: Under field- and lab-consistent parameter ranges, a serpentinization-fed, spatially resolved alkaline vent reproduces the conditions for a cellular origin: it crosses, in order, falsifiable thresholds for sustained carbon fixation, network persistence, concentration/individuality, compartmentation, internalized energy, and heritable organization — with identifiable parameter regions where each step fails.
